extraction.notes: Three-month 2024 column of Attachment 2 (p.3). FFO basic (213,785) is the ffo_total; the Series E preferred distributions (1,197) sit between basic and diluted FFO, so they are placed in core_adjustments as 'other' to tie to FFO as Adjusted diluted (221,027). The printed 'Total impact of adjustments to FFO' (6,045) equals the five adjustment lines excluding the preferred distributions. Net (gain)/loss on sale line shows '-' for 3Q 2024 and is recorded as 0. Starting net income (21,400) differs from the NOI reconciliation's net income attributable to UDR, Inc. (22,597) on Attachment 14(B); the Attachment 2 figure was used. Checks: 213,785/353,275 = 0.61 basic; 214,982/357,226 = 0.60 diluted; 221,027/357,226 = 0.62; 191,129/357,226 = 0.54. Recurring capex is deducted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
